concerns_addressed: ForecastService no longer exposes confidence or confidence_score; data_sufficiency is explicitly described as a non-probabilistic historical-period heuristic, and measurement.measured remains false with calibration deferred until outcomes exist (apps/api/app/Services/ForecastService.php:5-6, 48-62).

Recommendation metadata likewise identifies data_sufficiency as non-probabilistic and keeps measurement.measured false; the analytics page discloses the heuristic and unmeasured status for recommendations and forecasts (apps/api/app/Services/RecommendationService.php:63-76; apps/web/src/app/analytics/page.tsx:68-70).

Recommendation HTTP coverage now creates an inactive supplier and asserts its product is excluded, while the left-join predicate retains products with no supplier (apps/api/tests/Feature/AITest.php:49-78; apps/api/app/Services/RecommendationService.php:29-37).

Recommendation explanations distinguish outlet-scoped ranking from the admin global all-outlet ranking, with HTTP assertions for both scopes (apps/api/app/Services/RecommendationService.php:79-84; apps/api/tests/Feature/AITest.php:126-132).

The protected recommendations, forecast, and segmentation endpoints validate request parameters and enforce outlet self-scope versus admin aggregate/selected-outlet access (apps/api/routes/api.php:66-74; apps/api/app/Http/Controllers/AIController.php:17-96).

Recommendations remain deterministic and bounded to ten results, exclude cancelled/invalid orders, inactive products, unavailable stock, and inactive suppliers; legacy products without suppliers remain eligible (apps/api/app/Services/RecommendationService.php:19-52).

Forecasting remains deterministic and bounded by validated horizon, a 366 daily-bucket history cap, positive totals, excluded statuses, and safe insufficient-history fallback; grouped daily/weekly/monthly predictions are generated only with at least three periods (apps/api/app/Services/ForecastService.php:17-83).

Segmentation remains deterministic, explainable, batched, capped at 100 active outlets for aggregate access, and returns a new/low-confidence fallback for sparse history (apps/api/app/Services/SegmentationService.php:17-113).

Sparse recommendations, forecasts, and segmentation, deterministic forecast repeatability, validation, supplier filtering, scope isolation, and global/outlet explanation behavior are covered by HTTP feature tests (apps/api/tests/Feature/AITest.php:49-132).

The focused AI suite passes 4 tests/47 assertions, the full API suite passes 74 tests/455 assertions with only the environment-gated PostgreSQL concurrency tests skipped, PHP syntax checks pass, and the web production build/type check passes.

strengths: Transparent rule-based and aggregate heuristics avoid complex ML dependencies and expose method/version metadata.
Deterministic ordering, bounded limits, validated inputs, history caps, and sparse fallbacks provide predictable resource and response behavior.
Authorization and outlet data isolation are centralized in AIController and exercised for recommendations, forecasts, and segmentation.
Inactive supplier filtering and no-supplier legacy product handling are implemented in the query predicate and covered through the endpoint.

The repair removes the misleading probability-like confidence_score field, documents non-probabilistic data sufficiency, keeps measured=false until calibration, and discloses that status in the decision-surface UI.
The implementation follows the Laravel service/controller and Next.js page patterns, has no hard-coded credentials or unsafe query interpolation, and passes the available automated quality checks.
